links.outcome: Generalization from phantom training data to patient data
links.effect: Models trained on phantom data generalize effectively to patients, with no evidence of phantom-specific adaptation. Numerical performance estimates were not reported.
links.quote: Finally, we validate clinical relevance by demonstrating that AI models trained on phantom data generalize effectively to patients and exhibit no evidence of phantom-specific adaptation.
